purpose: Complete hash pin for the upstream profile source tree and its source-level embedded-profile selection; no upstream code is built, loaded, or executed.

canonicalization.content: strict UTF-8; preserve an existing UTF-8 BOM; replace CRLF with LF; reject bare CR
canonicalization.catalogFraming: for each sorted entry: UTF-8 path, one NUL byte, canonical content bytes, one NUL byte

sourceEvidence.proves: intended profiles/**/*.json include, exact three-file exclusion, and LogicalName template

selection.deployableRule: included profile JSON has a non-empty descriptor string; the verifier additionally requires that its whitespace-stripped value is non-empty even-length hexadecimal

releaseDllComparison.observedBy: existing KSX static PE/resource probe over the hash-pinned official v1.6.1 HIDMaestro.Core.dll
releaseDllComparison.countMapping: source selection exactly explains 231 minus the three explicit exclusions equals 228; the pinned descriptor data exactly explains 130 deployable source profiles
reason: The release digest is framed over actual CLR manifest-resource names and the exact raw bytes embedded in the built DLL, not repository paths plus canonical source bytes.
The MSBuild source states a LogicalName template, but a read/hash-only source verifier does not evaluate MSBuild metadata or inspect the release PE resource table.
Checkout line-ending conversion can change raw resource bytes without changing this canonical source digest. Equal counts do not prove byte-for-byte resource identity.
